## Checklist

- [ ] `SKILL.md` remains concise and focused.
- [ ] YAML frontmatter contains only `name` and `description`.
- [ ] New detailed material is placed in `references/` when appropriate.
- [ ] New reference files are linked from `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] Examples avoid unlicensed copyrighted material.
- [ ] Current-event or factual examples distinguish facts from assumptions.
- [ ] Image guidance respects licensing and authenticity.
